cohort: locked: one pre-treatment RNA unit per patient, rna_day <= 0, n=674 (L.build_cohort)

comparator_richer_additions.categorical: none (the comparator keeps the locked ISS and gains no categorical variable)
comparator_richer_additions.numeric_baseline_rule: most recent harmonized value with day <= 0 relative to first treatment; no look-back limit; same-day ties -> median; negative/non-finite -> missing
comparator_richer_additions.numeric_missing_handling: fold-local median imputation + missing indicator (the locked age pattern)
comparator_richer_additions.standardization: all resulting columns standardized with the training-fold mean/SD (locked rule)

R-ISS.handling: never attached to the analysis frame; cohort coverage recorded descriptively only
R-ISS.reason: assessed but EXCLUDED before any fit: composite measure that overlaps with ISS and LDH (already in the comparator) and has substantial missingness (about 57% 'not_reported'/blank in the diagnosis table)

excluded.cytogenetic_FISH_flags: UNAVAILABLE: no del(17p), t(4;14) or 1q gain/amplification field exists in any ingested table; not searched for elsewhere

label: RICHER-BASELINE SURVIVAL SENSITIVITY (post-hoc, exploratory; internal validation only; not external validation; no causal claim)
metric: OOF Harrell C per repeat, averaged; delta = richer C0+RNA - richer C0
model: locked ridge Cox PH (Breslow), lambda grid, 5-fold inner CV by Harrell C, tie -> largest lambda
outer_cv: locked: 5 repeats x 5 folds, KFold(shuffle, seed 42 + repeat) on the sorted patient index
